newsitem.title: USA: Dollar Tree to build new corporate office.
newsitem.headline: Dollar Tree to build new corporate office.

text.p: Dollar Tree Stores Inc said on Tuesday it bought about 50 acres in Chesapeake, Va., to construct a new headquarters and distribution center.

The new headquarters will be 76,000 square feet, while the distribution center will be 400,000 square feet, with more than triple the capacity of the company's current center. In the first year of operations it will employ 275 people, and the company projects that number to rise to 400 over the next five years.
Dollar Tree is a discount variety store chain with 748 stores in 26 states.
